payload.explanation: The business request (session_5a19d3f52c49, pid 1735) is blocked on a transactionid lock held by session_5ed65a2f8367 (pid 1733), which executed the same UPDATE inventory SET stock=stock-1 WHERE product_id=1 and is now 'idle in transaction' waiting on ClientRead — an abandoned/uncommitted transaction holding the row lock. Other idle sessions (session_13512a04ca0d, session_b98af297b9bc) run only SELECT 1 and are not blockers. No evidence of large data, index, or vacuum issues (single-row table, PK index only). Resolution: rollback_session on session_5ed65a2f8367, the eligible project-owned blocker, preserving the business request. Uncertainty: none material; blocking chain is directly observed via pg_blocking_pids.
